name: progress
summary: A bar, ring or segments with a glowing head; finishing flashes and draws a check.
props: Horizontal bar, circular ring, or a row of segments.
0 → max (completed steps for steps). Omit for indeterminate.
Comet sweep on the bar, spinning arc on the ring.
Segment count for the steps variant.
Fill colour (solid); the track, glow and pulse are tints of it.
Caption above the bar or under the ring.
Show the percentage (a drawn check once complete).
At max, flash the fill and turn the value into a drawn check.
Animated diagonal stripes on the linear fill for processing states.
Style for the root view of the bar, ring or step row.
behavior: The fill springs to each value with a glow riding its head, and the ring's percentage counts up. Reaching max flashes the fill and morphs the value into a drawn check.
The completion flash, moving stripes and segment pop and pulse are skipped. The fill still springs and indeterminate loops still run.
A progressbar with your label and its min, max and current value. Indeterminate progress is marked busy.
Transforms and opacity use the native driver; only the ring's SVG stroke and the check drawing use the JS driver.
